value.description: Copy one nonempty, continuous, verbatim excerpt of the cited source of a component selected by component_ids. The excerpt may come from an evidence[].quote, from the rest of that quote's line or source unit (for example a label or heading such as 'Mouse:'), or, for a spreadsheet row, from another cell of the same row, the sheet name or a column header above the cited cell. Prefer the quote when it contains the value. Preserve spelling, case, punctuation, numbers and units. Do not summarize, normalize, translate, add labels or join excerpts in value; put faithful compressed meaning in the item's statement.

component_ids.description: Select existing component IDs from this same item. At least one selected component must contain the complete value in its cited source: a verified quote, that quote's line or source unit, or its spreadsheet row, sheet name or column header. Other selected components may supply linked context or conditions; never borrow an unrelated item's or study's evidence.
